name: Supernatural Investigator Chat
source:
House of three cute girls is haunted and they called you - supernatural investigator Chat for help. The fate of this girls is in your hands. Will they survive through the night?

Short fangame about three vtubers: Freyaguma, Inislein and Kitanya, voice acted by the girls themselves.

[From [url=https://ukigumosama.itch.io/supernatural-investigator-chat]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三个可爱女孩的房子闹鬼，他们打电话给你 - 超自然调查员聊天寻求帮助。这个女孩的命运掌握在你的手中。他们能熬过这一夜吗？

关于三位vtuber的短同人游戏：Freyaguma、Inislein和Kitanya，由女孩们自己配音。

[来自[url=https://ukigumosama.itch.io/supernatural-investigator-chat]Itch.io[/url]]
